_comment: Multi-user auth. Copy to users.json and set AUTH_ENABLED=true. Only SHA-256 hashes of API keys are stored — generate entries with: python -m app.core.auth add <name> <role>. Roles: viewer < tester < admin. When AUTH_ENABLED is false the app runs open in single-user (local-admin) mode. 'engagements' is optional and off by default: omit it (or leave it empty) and that user sees every engagement on this box, exactly like before this field existed. List the engagement names (from ENGAGEMENTS_DIR, or the legacy single-engagement name) a user should be scoped to, and everything else — reading another engagement's assessments, evidence, exports, or switching to it in the sidebar — is refused with a 403.
